[SWS_Dem_01390] Behavior of Dem_ResetMonitorStatus ⌈The function Dem_-
ResetMonitorStatus shall set the monitor status bit 0 (TestFailed) to 0 and reset
the Dem-internal debounce algorithm to initial values if configured.⌋
Note: The function Dem_ResetMonitorStatus does not change the UDS status
byte and does not clear the pre-stored freeze frame.
